changed.title: Evenly spaced retained word positions minimize both clause and literal counts in binary cycle feasibility CNFs
changed.statement:
∀ (n b : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (hb : 0 < b), b ≤ n → ∀ origin : Fin n,
  let E := Fin n × (Bool × Bool)
  let V := Sum (Fin b) E
  let pos := fun idx : ℕ => (⟨idx % n, Nat.mod_lt _ hn⟩ : Fin n)
  let valid := fun lengths : Fin b → ℕ => (∀ i, 0 < lengths i) ∧ (∑ i, lengths i) = n
  let balanced := fun distances : Fin b → ℕ => ∀ i j, distances i ≤ distances j + 1
  let enc := fun (layout : Fin b → ℕ) (F : Finset (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause V)) =>
    ∀ a : V → Bool,
      (∃ x : Fin n → Bool, (∀ site : Fin n, a (Sum.inr
          (site, x site, x (pos (site.val + 1)))) = true) ∧
        ∀ i : Fin b, x (pos (origin.val + ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.filter
          (fun z : Fin b => z.val < i.val), layout j)) = a (Sum.inl i)) ↔
      PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Satisfies a (↑F : Set _)
  let clauses := fun h : ℕ => (if b = 1 then 7 else 9) * 2 ^ (h-1) - h - 4
  let literals := fun size : ℕ => if size = 1 then (if b = 1 then 4 else 12)
    else (if b = 1 then 7*size else 9*size+6) * 2 ^ (size-1) - 4
  let best := fun f : ℕ → ℕ => (b - n % b) * f (n / b) + n % b * f (n / b + 1)
  (∃ gap : Fin b → ℕ, valid gap ∧ balanced gap) ∧
    ∀ gap : Fin b → ℕ, valid gap →
      let C := ∑ i, clauses (gap i)
      let L := ∑ i, literals (gap i)
      (∃ F : Finset (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause V),
        enc gap F ∧ F.card = C ∧ (∑ item ∈ F, item.card) = L) ∧
      (∀ G : Finset (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause V), enc gap G →
        C ≤ G.card ∧ L ≤ ∑ item ∈ G, item.card) ∧
      best clauses ≤ C ∧ best literals ≤ L ∧
      (C = best clauses ↔ balanced gap) ∧ (L = best literals ↔ balanced gap)

changed.title: The exact parity leaf budget for disjoint products on a coset with up to two binary checks
changed.statement:
∀ (m e L : Nat),
  let F := ZMod 2
  let Q := Fin 2 → F
  let I := Fin m
  let X := I → Fin 2 → F
  ∀ (c : I → Fin 2 → Q) (base : X),
    let H := List Bool
    let D := X →ₗ[F] F
    let run := fun (T : Finset H) (ask : H → D) (bias : H → F) (x : X) =>
      (List.range T.card).foldl (fun (p : H) _ =>
        if p ∈ T then p ++ [decide (ask p x + bias p ≠ 0)] else p) []
    let syndrome := fun (x : X) (j : Fin 2) => ∑ i : I, ∑ u : Fin 2, (c i u j) * x i u
    let labels := (Finset.univ : Finset I).biUnion (fun i => ({c i 0, c i 1} : Finset Q))
    let h := Module.finrank F (Submodule.span F (↑labels : Set Q))
    let fullPair := ∃ i, c i 0 ≠ 0 ∧ c i 1 ≠ 0 ∧ c i 0 ≠ c i 1
    let r := m-e
    let p := if h = 0 then r else if h = 1 ∨ fullPair then r-1
      else (r-2) + (if r = 2 ∧ (labels.erase 0).card = 3 then 1 else 0)
    (∃ (T : Finset H) (ask : H → D) (bias : H → F) (P : H → I → D) (d : H → I → F),
      T.card < L ∧ ∀ x : X, syndrome x = syndrome base →
        let path := run T ask bias x
        ((Finset.univ : Finset I).filter (fun i => x i 0 * x i 1 ≠ P path i x+d path i)).card ≤ e) ↔
      2^p ≤ L

changed.title: The number of true pair probes in a uniform fitting optimal fan-in-two AND/OR equality function has a Poisson binomial law
changed.statement:
∀ (n : Nat), 2 ≤ n →
  ∀ (pos : List (Finset (Fin n))) (neg : List (Finset (Fin n) × Finset (Fin n))),
  (∀ R ∈ pos, R.card ≤ 3) →
  (∀ i : Fin n, (pos.toFinset.filter (fun R => R.card = 3 ∧ i ∈ R)).card ≤ 2) →
  let Fn := (Fin n → Bool) → (Fin n → Bool) → Bool
  let obs := fun (f : Fn) (R S : Finset (Fin n)) =>
    f (fun i => decide (i ∈ R)) (fun j => decide (j ∈ S))
  let fits := fun f : Fn => (∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit,
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 C ∧ C.size+1 ≤ 2*n ∧
    PEqualNP.Represents.Represents (fun i j : Fin n => decide (i=j)) C ∧
    ∀ x y, f x y = C.eval (List.ofFn x ++ List.ofFn y)) ∧
    (∀ R ∈ pos, obs f R ∅ = true) ∧ (∀ z ∈ neg, obs f z.1 z.2 = false)

  let size := fun f : Fn => (Finset.univ.filter (fun z : Fin n × Fin n =>
    z.1 < z.2 ∧ obs f {z.1,z.2} ∅ = true)).card
  let hist := fun s : Nat => Nat.card {f : Fn // fits f ∧ size f = s}

  let total := Nat.card {f : Fn // fits f}

    (∃ p : Fin d → ℝ, (∀ j, 0 ≤ p j ∧ p j ≤ 1) ∧ ∀ x : ℝ,
      (Finset.range (d+1)).sum (fun s => (hist s : ℝ)*x^s) =

    (∀ z : ℂ, (Finset.range (d+1)).sum (fun s => (hist s : ℂ)*z^s) = 0 →
      z.im = 0 ∧ z.re ≤ 0) ∧
    ∀ s : Nat, 0 < s → s < d →
      hist (s-1)*hist (s+1)*(d.choose s)^2 ≤
        (hist s)^2 * d.choose (s-1) * d.choose (s+1)

changed.statement:
∀ (N g t r s : ℕ), 0 < r → r ≤ s → r+s = g+1 → r*s < N →
  2*g+1 < N → N < 2*t → t < N →
  let X := Fin N
  let Circ := PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit
  let tab := fun (C : Circ) (x y : X) => C.eval (PEqualNP.Represents.oneEach x y)
  let A := (g+1)*N-r*s
  let fits := fun (C : Circ) =>
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (N+N) C ∧ C.output < N+N+C.size ∧
    (∀ gate ∈ C.gates, gate.inputs.length ≤ 2 ∧
      (gate.op = .or ∨ gate.op = .and ∨ (gate.op = .not ∧ gate.inputs.length = 1))) ∧
    C.size ≤ g ∧ ((Finset.univ : Finset (X × X)).filter (fun z => tab C z.1 z.2)).card ≤ A
  let reg := fun (T : X → X → Bool) =>
    (∀ x, (Finset.univ.filter (fun y => T x y)).card = t) ∧
    (∀ y, (Finset.univ.filter (fun x => T x y)).card = t)
  let loss := fun (C : Circ) (T : X → X → Bool) =>
    ((Finset.univ : Finset (X × X)).filter (fun z => tab C z.1 z.2 ≠ T z.1 z.2)).card
  let bench := N*(N*t)-(2*t-N)*A
  let valid := fun (M : ℕ) (D : Fin M → Circ) (w : Fin M → ℝ) =>
    (∀ i, fits (D i) ∧ 0 < w i) ∧ ∑ i, w i = 1
  let err := fun (M : ℕ) (D : Fin M → Circ) (w : Fin M → ℝ) (T : X → X → Bool) =>
    (N : ℝ)*∑ i, w i*(loss (D i) T : ℝ)

  let cov := fun (n m : ℕ) (S : Fin m → Finset (Fin n)) (v : Fin m → ℝ) =>
    (∀ i, (S i).card = s ∧ 0 < v i) ∧ ∀ y, (∑ i, if y ∈ S i then v i else 0) = 1
  let K := fun n : ℕ => sInf {m : ℕ | ∃ S v, cov n m S v}
  let shore := fun (M : ℕ) (D : Fin M → Circ) (w : Fin M → ℝ) =>
    ∃ (swap : Bool) (R : Finset X) (S : Fin M → Finset X), R.card = r ∧
      cov N M S (fun i => (N : ℝ)*w i/(s : ℝ)) ∧
      ∀ (i : Fin M) (x y : X), (if swap then tab (D i) y x else tab (D i) x y) =
        decide (x ∈ R ∨ y ∈ S i)
  let short := (K N)*(r+s-1) < 2*N-1 ∧ (r=s ∨ (K N)*r < N)

    (∀ M : ℕ, (∃ D w, valid M D w ∧ good M D w) ↔ K N ≤ M) ∧
    (∀ (D : Fin (K N) → Circ) (w : Fin (K N) → ℝ), valid (K N) D w →
      (good (K N) D w ↔ shore (K N) D w)) ∧
    (4*s^3 ≤ N → K N = K (2*s*s+N % s) + (N-(2*s*s+N % s))/s) ∧
    ∀ q : ℕ, 0 < q → Even s → N = q*s+s/2 →
      K N = q+2 ∧ ∀ (D : Fin (q+2) → Circ) (w : Fin (q+2) → ℝ),
        valid (q+2) D w → good (q+2) D w →
        ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (q+2))).filter (fun i => (N : ℝ)*w i < (s : ℝ))).card = 3 ∧
        ∀ i, (N : ℝ)*w i = (s : ℝ) ∨ 2*(N : ℝ)*w i = (s : ℝ)
